anfractuosities.translation: n. 弯曲；弯曲的水道；复杂或曲折的过程

anfractuosity.definition:
n. A state of being anfractuous, or full of windings
   and turnings; sinuosity.
n. A sinuous depression or sulcus like those separating
   the convolutions of the brain.
anfractuosity.translation:
n. 千回百折, 错综复杂, 弯曲的道路
[医] 纡曲, 弯曲, 脑沟

anfractuous.definition: s. full of twists and turns
anfractuous.translation:
a. 千回百折的, 错综复杂的, 弯曲的
[医] 纡曲的, 弯曲的
